name: KY-052 pressure and temperature sensor (BMP280)
not_buildable: It talks over a data bus (I2C). It needs an extra Arduino library, and LearnLens only compiles sketches with its two approved libraries.
identification: Small square black PCB printed BMP280 with a tiny silver sensor can and 6 header pins.

facts.statement: The BMP280 measures air pressure (300 to 1100 hPa) and temperature and reports them over I2C or SPI. The vendor's example uses the Adafruit BMP280 library.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-052, technical data and code example
